description: This is a PHP source file that defines a class 'Theme' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension'. The class handles extension theme management functionalities including listing available themes, installation, and uninstallation processes within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin interface.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class managing theme extensions in the admin interface of OpenCart, providing methods to list, install, and uninstall themes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of themes by calling getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the list of available themes, their installation status across stores, and related actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a theme extension, including permission checks, registering controllers, models, and directories, and invoking extension-specific install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a theme extension, including permission checks and invoking extension-specific uninstall scripts.
